headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token matching the server MCP_BEARER_TOKEN. Send as: Bearer <token>

MCP_HTTP_HOST.description: Public hostname of your deployed Streamable HTTP server (no scheme or path). Set from your host's URL, e.g. the Fly/Railway hostname.
